name: Spotify
description: Puts the cover of whatever you are playing behind the dashboard, with the track and the transport controls in a panel of their own.
author: oliverbravery

reasons.net: To ask Spotify what is playing and to fetch the cover.
reasons.oauth: To sign you in to Spotify, which is the only way it can see your player.
reasons.background: To put the cover of the current track behind the dashboard.
